interface.title: Whombat (v0.9.0)
interface.field: Bioacoustics / audio annotation for machine learning
interface.stage_of_work: Data curation and annotation: building labelled training and evaluation sets from field recordings
interface.what_it_is_for: Register a folder of audio recordings, cut them into clips for annotation tasks, draw time-frequency boxes on spectrograms and tag them with species labels, track progress, explore the annotated events, and export the project as AOEF JSON for ML training.

data.note: Registered the server-side folder /work/app/example_data/audio, which holds ten Xeno-canto Neotropical bat echolocation recordings, as the dataset 'Neotropical bat calls'. Whombat indexed duration, sample rate (375–500 kHz) and channels for all 10, with 0 metadata issues and 0 missing files. No files were uploaded. Setup (deployment, not part of the workflow): created the first local admin account (bioac) with the /first form (username, name, email, password twice; screens/002.webp, screens/003.webp), then signed in at http://localhost:5000/login (screens/005.webp). The replay found that signing in on http://127.0.0.1:5000 looped back to /login (the session cookie did not take on that host), while http://localhost:5000 worked.

features.name: Interactive spectrogram viewer with box zoom and STFT/de-noise settings
features.general: Show a signal as a time-frequency image, zoom into a region by drawing a box, and change transform parameters and noise suppression until faint events stand out
features.specific: Recording or clip spectrogram with home, back, pan and zoom tools, an audio player bar, a minimap scrollbar, and a Settings drawer (resampling, frequency filter range, window size, overlap, window function, PCEN de-noise, Reset/Save). Back, Reset and Save were not tried
steps: open a recording or clip to see its spectrogram
pick the zoom tool and drag a box over the region of interest
open Settings and drag the Window size slider from the default 8192 to a short window (a few hundred samples)
switch on De-noise (PCEN)
close the drawer to see the redrawn spectrogram (Save, which should keep the settings, was not tried)
serves_tasks: Inspect one recording's spectrogram and tune its display to make the signal visible
Mark each sound event with a time-frequency box and give it a label

features.name: Bounding-box annotation on a spectrogram with a tag palette
features.general: Pick the active label(s) first, then draw boxes over events on a 2-D image. Each new box carries the active labels, shows its measured extent, and can be resized with handles
features.specific: Tag Palette plus the draw tool on the clip spectrogram. Each box becomes a sound event tagged with the palette tags, and Sound Event Details show duration, freqLow, freqHigh and bandwidth, which update as you drag the handles
steps: type in the Tag Palette and choose a tag (e.g. species Carollia perspicillata)
press the draw tool
drag a box over a call on the spectrogram
read the auto-computed duration and frequency bounds in Sound Event Details
drag a box handle to tighten the box, and the measurements update
serves_tasks: Mark each sound event with a time-frequency box and give it a label

features.name: Clip-extraction task builder with live count
features.general: Turn long recordings into fixed-length work units: choose the source, optionally filter or subsample, set unit length, overlap and a per-source cap, and watch the predicted number of units before committing
features.specific: Add Tasks page: Select Dataset, Filter recordings, Subsample recordings, Clip Length, Overlap, Subsample clips, a Summary showing 'Tasks to add', and Add Clips. Filter recordings, Subsample recordings and Overlap were not tried
steps: choose a dataset in the search box
set Clip Length (10 s → 1 s took tasks from 10 to 33)
switch on Subsample clips and set a maximum per recording (2 → 20 tasks)
press Add Clips, and the project overview shows the new task total
serves_tasks: Generate annotation tasks by cutting recordings into fixed-length clips

features.name: Key:value tag vocabulary picker with create-on-the-fly
features.general: Build a controlled list of key:value labels for a project by searching existing labels, creating missing ones inline, and seeing the chosen set
features.specific: Project Tags page: an Add Tags combobox (type key:value; if no tag matches, create it with 'click here') and a Selected tags list. Shift+Enter is not a reliable way to create a tag: in this run it created the tag without adding it to the project and produced a malformed stray tag. Removing a tag by clicking it was not tried. The species key is exported as dwc:scientificName
steps: type a tag in key:value form
if no tag matches, create it with 'click here'
pick the option to add it to the project
see it under Selected tags, with its count
serves_tasks: Define the label vocabulary annotators may use

features.name: Task queue with status buttons and progress dashboard
features.general: Step through work items one at a time, mark each done, and see the status counts and per-label usage across the project
features.specific: Annotate header (task #, Progress bar, Remaining n/20, prev/next arrows, Filter) with check / cross / shield buttons; only the check (Completed) was used, the cross (Need Review), shield (Verified), arrows and Filter were not. The Overview shows Remaining / Need Review / Completed / Verified and a Project Tags table of clip and sound-event counts

read per-tag sound-event counts in Project Tags

Review labelling progress and how often each label is used
